text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This is a research article presenting a spatially explicit, national-scale (Brazil-wide) land-use and land-cover (LULC) modeling study using the GLOBIOM-Brazil model. The primary focus is on future LULC prediction and simulation under multiple scenarios of enforcement of Brazil’s Forest Code out to 2050. The model outputs include mapped LULC projections at a 50 km × 50 km grid, with quantitative comparisons across seven scenarios including full enforcement, partial enforcement, and no enforcement. The study reports quantitative metrics such as accumulated deforestation, changes in cropland and pasture areas, cattle herd sizes, and forest restoration extent. The methodology clearly describes national-scale spatial implementation and the results include spatially explicit maps and quantitative accuracy validation against historical data. The paper does not focus on species-specific ecology, biomass/carbon only, or purely qualitative analysis, nor is it a review. Therefore, it meets all core inclusion criteria and no exclusion criteria.)
